acceptance: The decision record matches the merged behaviour of all run-timeout steps and cites them.
description:
## Problem
`_project/decisions/run-timeout-2026-11-20.md` describes only step 1a. It is now wrong in places: line ~30 says a running generator is not interrupted at the limit and line ~57 says `generate_data()` is not stopped until generators are routed through the deadline (both changed by #4434: dbgen, dsdgen, qgen, dsqgen and the tool builds are ended at the limit); the Delivery section (~90) lists the later changes as future work. Not recorded: remote cleanup and its 25-second graceful wait within the 30-second grace (#4435), power tests stopped at the limit report no Power@Size (#4435), plan capture bounded by min(setting, remaining) and raising/recording the run timeout (#4437), UAT `timed-out` vs `hung` (#4437), removal of the unused timers and config keys (#4437), and the generation estimate (#4439).

## Change
Update the decision record so it states the decisions as delivered, with the owner's quoted decisions from run-timeout-plan-20261120, and link the pull requests. Keep rejected alternatives that still apply.

## Decision gates
Record only decisions the owner made or the merged code implements; anything else is a question for the owner, not a new decision. Owner texts and limits verbatim.

## Verification rubric
Each statement in the record checked against develop code (cite file paths); no statement contradicts the merged behaviour; `make docs-reference-inventory-check` and `make pr-preflight` exit 0.

## Guardrails
Work in a linked worktree (`make worktree-create`), never the primary clone. Edit files with the edit tool, never by script. Heavy work (benchmarks, test tiers, UAT, generators at scale) only through `make heavy-run` or lock-taking entry points; never skip the lock, admission or watchdog; never delete anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`. No live cloud run and no cloud credentials unless this item's Decision gates say the owner approved it in the current task. BenchBox imposes no default run limit: add none. No comments or docstrings in first-party code; one changelog fragment for a user-facing change. Never post a stand-in review, close and reopen a pull request to restart CI, use `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite an author. Arm once; a second time only after fixing the cause the refusal named. Reply on every review thread; resolve it only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise it again.
